nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of Mn-doped Co(OH)2 precursors
nodes.procedure: The Mn-doped Co(OH)2 precursors with varied Mn feeding moles of 0, 0.25, 0.5, and 1 mmol on CC were prepared (denoted as Co(OH)2/CC, Mn0.1-Co(OH)2/CC, Mn0.15-Co(OH)2/CC and Mn0.2-Co(OH)2/CC). Mn-doped Co(OH)2 precursors present the nanowire arrays uniform growth on the surface of carbon cloth (Figures S1 and S2, Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: First, the Mn-doped Co(OH)2 precursors with varied Mn feeding moles of 0, 0.25, 0.5, and 1 mmol on CC were prepared (denoted as Co(OH)2/CC, Mn0.1-Co(OH)2/CC, Mn0.15-Co(OH)2/CC and Mn0.2-Co(OH)2/CC). Mn-doped Co(OH)2 precursors present the nanowire arrays uniform growth on the surface of carbon cloth.

nodes.name: Low-temperature phosphorization
nodes.procedure: By further low-temperature phosphating Mn-doped Co(OH)2 precursors at 350°C for 1 h, the corresponding Mn_x-CoP/CC samples were obtained (labeled as CoP/CC, Mn0.1-CoP/CC, Mn0.15-CoP/CC, and Mn0.2-CoP/CC), where the accurate content of Mn is determined by inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES) (Table S1, Supporting Information). After phosphorization, the nanowires structure is well maintained, but the surface of the nanowires becomes rougher.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows nanowires structure well maintained after phosphorization but surface becomes rougher for all Mn_x-CoP/CC samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After phosphorization, the nanowires structure is well maintained, but the surface of the nanowires becomes rougher (Figure 1b-e), verified by scanning electron microscopy (SEM)

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show rough nanowires for CoP/CC and Mn0.15-CoP/CC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images of CoP/CC and Mn_{0.15}-CoP/CC were performed to investigate the role of Mn doping.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows clear lattice fringes with interplanar distance of 0.188 nm for (211) plane of CoP/CC and 0.191 nm for Mn0.15-CoP/CC proving lattice expansion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM and HRTEM images of CoP/CC exhibit... clear lattice fringes with interplanar distances of 0.188 nm... for Mn_{0.15}-CoP/CC... interplanar distances of the (211) plane of CoP increase to 0.191 nm

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM mapping confirms uniform distribution of Co, Mn, and P elements on nanowires of Mn0.15-CoP/CC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM mapping images (Figure 1h) confirm the uniform distribution of Co, Mn, and P elements on the nanowires

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show orthorhombic CoP (PDF #29-0497) for all samples with (211) peak shifting to lower angle with increasing Mn content, confirming lattice expansion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) was performed... the (211) diffraction peak gradually shifts to a low-angle with the increase of Mn doping in the CoP

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Co 2p XPS shows Co-P (778.6/793.6 eV), CoII-O (781.8/798.3 eV) peaks shifting to higher binding energy with Mn doping; Mn 2p shows Mn2+ (640.7 eV), Mn3+ (642.6 eV), Mn4+ (644.6 eV); P 2p shifts to lower binding energy.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution Co XPS spectra (Figure 2b) present three pairs of peaks, corresponding to Co-P (778.6 and 793.6 eV), Co^{II}-O (781.8 and 798.3 eV)... The high-resolution Mn 2p spectra can be deconvoluted into three peaks (Figure 2c), indexing to Mn^{2+} (640.7 eV), Mn^{3+} (642.6 eV), and Mn^{4+} (644.6 eV)

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge XANES: Co valence states +2.09 (CoP/CC), +2.24 (Mn0.1), +2.26 (Mn0.15), +2.33 (Mn0.2); Mn K-edge: +3.27 (Mn0.1), +3.20 (Mn0.15), +3.07 (Mn0.2); P K-edge shifts lower with Mn content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the average valence states of Co are +2.09, +2.24, +2.26, and +2.33 for CoP/CC, Mn_{0.1}-CoP/CC, Mn_{0.15}-CoP/CC, and Mn_{0.2}-CoP/CC... The average valence states of Mn are quantified to be +3.27, +3.20, and +3.07

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS shows Co-P bond length stretching and lattice expansion with increasing Mn content; WT-EXAFS confirms Co-P bond stretching.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co K-edge Fourier transform extended X-ray absorption fine structure (FT-EXAFS) presents... The Co-P bond length is stretched as Mn content elevates

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES determines accurate Mn content in Mn_x-CoP/CC samples (Table S1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: the accurate content of Mn is determined by inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES) (Table S1, Supporting Information)

nodes.characterization_summary: Work function of Mn0.15-CoP/CC is higher than other Mn_x-CoP/CC samples and close to Pt.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the work function (WF) of the samples was calculated by using the scanning Kelvin probe. The WF value of Mn_{0.15}-CoP/CC is higher than that of CoP/CC, Mn_{0.1}-CoP/CC, and Mn_{0.2}-CoP/CC, and close to that of Pt
